% Geography from a formula game (generated by figs_c3ch10.py).
\begin{tikzpicture}[x=10mm,y=8mm,every node/.style={font=\scriptsize},
  v/.style={circle,draw=MidnightBlue,fill=white,minimum size=5.5mm,inner sep=0pt},
  cl/.style={circle,draw=BurntOrange,fill=BurntOrange!20,minimum size=6mm,inner sep=0pt},
  a/.style={-{Stealth},MidnightBlue!80}]
\node[v,fill=MidnightBlue!15] (T1) at (0,0) {$T_1$};
\node[v] (L1) at (-1,-1) {$L_1$};
\node[v] (R1) at (1,-1) {$R_1$};
\node[v] (B1) at (0,-2) {$B_1$};
\draw[a] (T1) -- (L1); \draw[a] (T1) -- (R1); \draw[a] (L1) -- (B1); \draw[a] (R1) -- (B1);
\node[anchor=east,font=\scriptsize] at (-1.5,-1) {E chooses $x_1$};
\node[v,fill=MidnightBlue!15] (T2) at (0,-3) {$T_2$};
\node[v] (L2) at (-1,-4) {$L_2$};
\node[v] (R2) at (1,-4) {$R_2$};
\node[v] (B2) at (0,-5) {$B_2$};
\draw[a] (T2) -- (L2); \draw[a] (T2) -- (R2); \draw[a] (L2) -- (B2); \draw[a] (R2) -- (B2);
\node[anchor=east,font=\scriptsize] at (-1.5,-4) {A chooses $x_2$};
\node[v,fill=MidnightBlue!15] (T3) at (0,-6) {$T_3$};
\node[v] (L3) at (-1,-7) {$L_3$};
\node[v] (R3) at (1,-7) {$R_3$};
\node[v] (B3) at (0,-8) {$B_3$};
\draw[a] (T3) -- (L3); \draw[a] (T3) -- (R3); \draw[a] (L3) -- (B3); \draw[a] (R3) -- (B3);
\node[anchor=east,font=\scriptsize] at (-1.5,-7) {E chooses $x_3$};
\draw[a] (B1) -- (T2);
\draw[a] (B2) -- (T3);
\node[v,fill=MidnightBlue!15] (c) at (0,-9) {$c$};
\draw[a] (B3) -- (c);
\node[cl] (c1) at (3.2,-6.5) {$c_1$};
\node[cl] (c2) at (3.2,-9.5) {$c_2$};
\draw[a] (c) -- (c1); \draw[a] (c) -- (c2);
\draw[-{Stealth},BurntOrange,thick] (c1) to[out=90,in=0] (R1);
\draw[-{Stealth},BurntOrange,thick] (c1) to[out=120,in=0] (L2);
\draw[-{Stealth},BurntOrange,thick] (c1) to[out=180,in=0] (R3);
\draw[-{Stealth},BurntOrange,thick] (c2) to[out=60,in=-20] (L1);
\draw[-{Stealth},BurntOrange,thick] (c2) to[out=150,in=-10] (R2);
\node[anchor=west,align=left] at (3.8,-6.5) {$c_1=x_1\lor\neg x_2\lor x_3$};
\node[anchor=west,align=left] at (3.8,-9.5) {$c_2=\neg x_1\lor x_2$};
\node[anchor=east,font=\scriptsize] at (-1.5,-9) {A chooses a clause};
